mapper.update: UPDATE fulfillment_runtime_mode SET mode=#{mode} WHERE singleton_id=1 AND mode IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT mode FROM fulfillment_runtime_mode WHERE singleton_id=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT mode FROM fulfillment_runtime_mode WHERE singleton_id=1 FOR SHARE

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pending, COUNT(CASE WHEN status='REVIEW_REQUIRED' THEN 1 END) AS review_required, COUNT(CASE WHEN status='PENDING' AND lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN 1 END) AS expired_leases, COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(CASE WHEN status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN next_attempt_at END), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)),0) AS oldest_due_seconds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fulfillment_shadow_quarantine) AS quarantined FROM ( SELECT status,next_attempt_at,lease_until FROM fulfillment_shipment_jobs WHERE status IN ('PENDING','REVIEW_REQUIRED') UNION ALL SELECT status,next_attempt_at,lease_until FROM fulfillment_merchant_jobs WHERE status IN ('PENDING','REVIEW_REQUIRED') ) AS outstanding
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fulfillment_order_locks (order_id) VALUES (#{orderId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_id=order_id
INSERT INTO fulfillment_command_ids (command_id,order_id) VALUES (#{commandId},#{orderId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE order_id=order_id
mapper.select: SELECT order_id FROM fulfillment_command_ids WHERE command_id=#{commandId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fulfillment_shipment_jobs WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status IN ('PENDING','REVIEW_REQUIRED') UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM fulfillment_merchant_jobs WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND status IN ('PENDING','REVIEW_REQUIRED') )

SELECT command_id,order_id,merchant_id,'SHIP' AS operation,order_number, carrier,tracking_number,NULL AS expected_version,NULL AS detail,step,status,last_error AS error_code FROM fulfillment_shipment_jobs WHERE command_id=#{commandId} UNION ALL SELECT command_id,order_id,merchant_id,operation,NULL AS order_number,carrier,tracking_number, CASE WHEN operation='UPDATE_SHIPMENT' THEN expected_version END,detail,step,status,last_error FROM fulfillment_merchant_jobs WHERE command_id=#{commandId}

SELECT command_id,order_id,merchant_id,'SHIP' AS operation,order_number,carrier,tracking_number, NULL AS expected_version,NULL AS detail,step,status,last_error AS error_code FROM fulfillment_shipment_jobs WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY () ASC,created_at DESC,command_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT command_id FROM
fulfillment_shipment_jobs WHERE order_id=#{command.orderId} AND NOT () ORDER BY created_at DESC,command_id DESC
fulfillment_merchant_jobs WHERE order_id=#{command.orderId} AND operation=#{command.operation} AND expected_version=COALESCE(#{command.expectedShipmentVersion},0) AND NOT (operation='CONFIRM' AND step='ORDER' AND status='REJECTED' AND COALESCE(last_error,'')='ORDER_MUTATION_REJECTED') ORDER BY updated_at DESC,command_id DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT command_id FROM ( SELECT command_id,next_attempt_at FROM fulfillment_shipment_jobs WHERE status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) UNION ALL SELECT command_id,next_attempt_at FROM fulfillment_merchant_jobs WHERE status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ) AS pending ORDER BY next_attempt_at,command_id LIMIT 10
mapper.sql: command_id=#{task.commandId} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE SET owner_token=#{owner}, lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,60,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)),attempts=attempts+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE command_id=#{task.commandId} AND status='PENDING' AND step=#{task.step} AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))

UPDATE SET status=CASE WHEN attempts >= 6 THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, last_error=#{error},owner_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), next_attempt_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,LEAST(POWER(2,attempts),30),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE
mapper.select: SELECT command_id FROM ( SELECT command_id,updated_at,order_id FROM fulfillment_shipment_jobs WHERE status='REVIEW_REQUIRED' UNION ALL SELECT command_id,updated_at,order_id FROM fulfillment_merchant_jobs WHERE status='REVIEW_REQUIRED' ) AS reviewable ORDER BY updated_at,order_id,command_id LIMIT #{limit}
